findings: Non-blocking (possible, by design): chooseLive prefers the spectator score the instant any total/goals/behinds field is a real number, so a genuine 0-0 at the opening bounce is pushed as 0-0; the summary is consulted for score only when the spectator feed is entirely null, not merely zero. Correct behaviour (summary is also 0/PENDING pre-game); noted for boundary clarity, no action required.
